title: The Maharashtra increase of Land Revenue and Special Assessment Act, 1974
full_text: The Maharashtra increase of Land Revenue and Special Assessment Act, 1974 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197420 Act Number: 20 Enactment Date: 1974-04-29 Act Year: 1974 Short Title: The Maharashtra increase of Land Revenue and Special Assessment Act, 1974 Long Title: An Act to provide for an increase of land revenue 2on certain holdings in the State; and also an increase of land revenue to be levied on the amount of special assessment levied on agricultural lands under the Maharashtra Education (Cess) Act, 1962.
